notes.title: Saloon Simulator roadmap
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear players![/b][/h1][p][/p]
[p]Thank you for supporting us during Early Access! Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us, which is why we want to share our plans for the future. We have prepared a [b]roadmap[/b] where you can see what we are currently working on and what new features and improvements are planned for upcoming updates.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/088dcdf7be15b579cc9df2824fd1a6b4aea6d80a.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p]Each chapter will bring at least [b]two major updates[/b] – a mid-patch and a release patch – along with several smaller updates packed with bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and even early access to finished parts of upcoming game mechanics.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p]As for the later stages, Chapters 4 and 5 will be revealed after we collect your feedback from Chapter 3. The roadmap will then be updated to reflect the direction we’re heading together.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p]Today we’re also releasing our last update before a longer break. We’re at the[b] final stage of designing the staff system[/b], and soon we’ll start working on the programming part of implementing them into the game.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]What’s new in today’s patch[/b][/p]
[list]
[*][b]New furniture sets [/b]– This patch introduces several new furniture sets that our artists didn’t manage to finish before the EA launch. Our broader plan is to add plenty more furniture in future updates, so that on each tier you’ll have multiple design variants to choose from, not just one.
[*][b]Improved woodwork and base furniture textures[/b] – We’ve refreshed not only the floors, but also wooden walls, beams, stairs, and exterior elements. Overall, the saloon’s woodwork has gone through a full visual overhaul to look more natural and detailed.
[*][b]Bug fixes[/b] – We’re constantly improving the game, and your bug reports have been a huge help. This patch fixes several softlocks in quests and issues with NPC movement in certain tasks. We’ll continue keeping a close eye on any other issues that pop up after this release - and we’ll tackle them right away.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/b7f2a8c9e80af5090a633697263642607acccfea.gif[/img]

[p][/p]
[p]We’d also like to invite you to our[b] new dedicated Saloon Simulator Discord server.[/b] Until now, our community has been split between two separate servers – ours (the dev team) and our publisher’s (RockGame). By bringing everyone together in one place, we’ll be able to stay in touch with you more easily, and you’ll also be able to get answers faster – especially if another player helps you out while it’s nighttime in our timezone.[/p]
[url=https://discord.gg/sfVazZ23Zz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/66e7e4a3587b6ea767c2ef3718da294bc1d480d8.png[/img][/url]

[p][/p]
[p]Finally, we’d like to thank you for the warm reception of Saloon Simulator’s Early Access. Your feedback – whether it’s in reviews, forum discussions, or on Discord – is helping us make the game better every day. Knowing that our work resonates with you and that you want to be part of shaping the game is truly a dream come true for every game developer.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p]We’re excited to keep developing the game and bringing you even more Saloon content![/p]
[p][/p]
[p]See you in Blueberry (and also on Discord!) [/p]
[p][/p]
Best, Glivi Games team.

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players,[/h3]

We’re back with another [b]hotfix[/b] packed with improvements, fixes, and some handy new options based on your feedback!

[list]
[*] [b]Toggleable sprint option added[/b] – You can now choose whether sprinting requires you to [i]hold[/i] the button or just [i]tap[/i] it to switch between walking and running. You’ll find this setting in the gameplay options.
[*] [b]Customer spawn rate is now adjustable[/b] – Some players found the saloon too busy, others thought it too quiet. You can now manually adjust the number of customers coming to your saloon in the [b]options menu[/b]. This is a [i]temporary solution[/i] while we work on a more advanced customer spawning system.
[*] [b]Translation fixes[/b] – We’ve corrected some localization issues in various languages.
[*] [b]Train performance optimized[/b] – You should notice smoother gameplay during train unloading sequences.
[*] [b]Minor texture optimizations[/b] – A few small tweaks were made to improve overall performance.
[/list]

The past few weeks have been focused mainly on [b]bugfixing the current version of the game[/b] and [b]planning our roadmap for the coming months[/b]. Once the planning phase is complete, we’ll share a full [b]development roadmap[/b] with you, so you’ll know exactly what new features to expect - and in what order.

But we can already confirm one thing: [b]the first major update will introduce employees![/b]
Tell us in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/sfVazZ23Zz]Discord[/url] - which staff member should we add first?
[b]The cook, the waiter, the cleaner, or the bartender?[/b]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

~The Saloon Simulator Team

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Dear players!

Thank you so much for the incredible interest in the Early Access release of Saloon Simulator! We’re currently rallying the team and preparing for our first major update—I'll keep you posted on our progress in the upcoming devlogs.

In the meantime, we’re rolling out a [b]hotfix [/b]that addresses some of the most common issues you've reported over the past few days:

[list]
[*] [b]Customer frequency reduced[/b] – Many of you told us that running the saloon can get a bit overwhelming in the later stages of the game. While we’re still working on implementing staff management in one of the upcoming major updates, this patch slightly slows down the rate at which customers appear. This should make gameplay more manageable—both in the final story chapters and in Freeplay mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where rugs would revert to their original color after loading a save.
[*] Fixed looping dialogue issues.
[*] Fixed shop display issues on non-standard screen resolutions.
[/list]
Plus several other small and medium bugs you’ve reported.

[b]And one more fun addition! [/b]To make a certain moment in the story a bit easier to manage (you’ll know when you get there), we’ve stashed some extra cash around town. Think you can climb the sheriff’s roof or peek inside the chimney next to the doctor’s house? Go take a look—it’ll be worth your while!

[h2]About game crashes
[/h2]
We’re aware of a stability issue that occurs on some hardware setups, causing the game to crash or behave unpredictably. We’re still investigating the root cause, but one workaround that often helps is running the game in [b]DirectX 11 mode[/b]. You can check out the GIF below for instructions on how to do that:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/e0b86e9f95db1e5eb75c8aaf6bc0ed077fb35ef8.gif[/img]

type: -dx11

Additionally, players using[b] Intel 13th and 14th gen processors[/b] have reported similar issues. In many cases, updating your BIOS seems to help.

Thanks again for all your support, feedback, and patience. 

~The Saloon Simulator Team

notes.title: Saloon Simulator is now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players,[/h3]

Saloon Simulator is kicking off its life as an Early Access game! We have big plans for the project and we want to shape them around your preferences and ideas. Over the next few months, we’ll be paying very close attention to your feedback—both here on Steam and over on our [b]Discord server[/b], where you’re warmly invited to join the conversation.

[h3]What’s included in the current Early Access version?[/h3]

[list]
[*] 34 quests that introduce the residents of Blueberry, the work of a saloon keeper, and all the mechanics and minigames we've built
[*] Expanded saloon management with rentable rooms and a full-fledged gambling den
[*] A robust Freeplay mode
[*] Brand-new furniture and decorative elements
[*] 2 new minigames: gold panning and unloading the train
[*] Full English voice-over performed by professional actors
[/list]
...and much, much more!

[previewyoutube=CHZDPvG2HE8;full][/previewyoutube]

While this version of the game has been thoroughly tested for over two months, you may still encounter bugs—we’ll be spending the upcoming weeks fixing and polishing based on your reports. Please don’t hesitate to let us know about any issues here on Steam or via Discord.

Early Access is a development phase—not a finished product. Our entire team will continue working on the game for many more months. We’ll be sharing our progress with you through [b]monthly devlogs[/b] here on Steam and on our Discord channel.

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

I’ve tried to answer most of your questions in the FAQ section on our Discord. But in case you’d rather not join just yet, here they are:

[b]I’m a content creator and would like a key to stream the game. What should I do?[/b]
Go to [https://rockgame.pl], click the “Request a Key” button in the top right corner, and select “Saloon Simulator” in the survey. Once you submit the form and meet the requirements, you should receive your key.
[b]
Do you plan to add a co-op mode?[/b]
Unfortunately, we don’t have any plans for that. Saloon was designed from the very beginning as a single-player experience, and adding online multiplayer would require rebuilding the core game code.

[b]I have access to Saloon Simulator Playtest but can’t launch it. Why?[/b]
Playtests are specific builds we released during development. The latest version available is the Saloon Simulator Prologue, which is an improved and polished build that you may have seen in the last playtests. I encourage you to try the Saloon Simulator Prologue—it’s completely free!

Saloon Simulator was created out of a deep love for the Wild West atmosphere. We truly hope that your visit to Blueberry will let you see it not just as it is—but as it could one day become.

As the Polish poetic duo Olga and Rafał Golec once said, words that guide our production more than you might think:

[i]Tu na razie jest ściernisko
Ale będzie San Francisco
A tam, gdzie to kretowisko
Będzie stał mój bank[/i]

[quote]Which roughly translates to:
[i]Right now, it's just a barren field
But soon it'll be San Francisco
And where there’s just a molehill now—
That's where my bank will stand[/i][/quote]

[h3]Join Our Discord![/h3]
We also invite you to join our Discord, where we answer all your questions. If you have anything you’d like to share with us, that’s the place to do it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/66e7e4a3587b6ea767c2ef3718da294bc1d480d8.png[/img]
https://discord.gg/sfVazZ23Zz

Once again—thank you all so much for the support and feedback you’ve shared with us so far. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the Early Access release!

notes.title: Progress Report January 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players,[/h1]

We kicked off the new year with a bang and have completed the implementation of one of the biggest updates in a long time. All dialogues and customer interactions in the saloon are now fully voice-acted! In addition to working on dubbing, we've also introduced improvements to the visuals and functionality of the town, making it easier for you to immerse yourself in the world we’ve created.

[h2]1. English Voice-Over[/h2]
In August 2024, we began casting for the roles of our main characters. We received over 700 applications, from which we selected 31 professional and non-professional actors to bring the residents of Blueberry and saloon customers to life. The recordings took place between September and October, while December and January were dedicated to integrating the voice-over into the game engine. You can hear the results of our and our actors' hard work in the preview below.

[previewyoutube=8ojeDWRV34k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]2. A Sky as Real as It Gets[/h2]
One of the most visually stunning additions to our game is the implementation of a dynamic sky. We've long known that the desert landscape would be a perfect backdrop for a realistic sky. This is one of our newest features, making a strong impression during the day and an even bigger impact at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/d9b7f8b67502937c0aa50182c67ba264a8c73f0f.gif[/img]

[h2]3. Horses Have Finally Arrived in Town[/h2]
While we decided early on that our protagonist would travel exclusively on foot, the same couldn't be said for merchants and visitors. Blueberry isn't a large town—you could say it’s a true "15-minute city." However, it lacked something crucial—horses. After all, the game is set in the Wild West, and what would a western be without horses? (Seriously—do you know of any westerns without horses?) Currently, horses don't move around town yet, but we plan to introduce this feature in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/25b5254c423983c7f2dced4ef24b054f463ae010.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/ec8e30d855f7dc49cba63cc07dcbcf7db2639182.gif[/img]

We encourage you to add Saloon Simulator and Saloon Simulator Prologue to your [b]wishlist[/b], ensuring you won't miss out on any updates or the game's release.

notes.title: Progress Report December 2024
notes.content:
[h1]What’s New in Saloon Simulator?
[/h1]
As the year comes to a close, it’s time to reflect. Over the past 12 months, Saloon Simulator has transformed beyond recognition. We’ve worked tirelessly on optimizations and features to enhance gameplay. Along the way, we encountered small bugs—fixed with just a couple of clicks—and some major ones that had us scratching our heads for hours. Throughout it all, your warm reception of the Saloon Simulator Prologue (691 reviews, with an impressive 88% positive rating!) has kept us motivated. Your feedback inspired us to collaborate[b] with 38 incredible voice actors[/b], who brought life to the characters and customers of the saloon in Blueberry.

[h2]1. Blueberry, Livelier Than Ever
[/h2]
Though Blueberry is filled with buildings and nooks to explore, it has sometimes felt lifeless. But Blueberry is far from a ghost town—as you discovered the moment you opened your saloon in the Prologue. We’ve begun work on a “living city” mechanic, bringing the townsfolk to life with activity on the streets. In the next phase, we plan to introduce routines and special animations for our NPCs, deepening your immersion in the world of Saloon Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/0a3e8613d28462d8c69adb96c8ba1243d2a7767a.gif[/img]


[h2]2. Live Music?
[/h2]
In Act Two, Robert—a ragtime-loving musician with a knack for trouble—will arrive in town. Before you can hire him to play at your saloon, you’ll need to help him escape his biggest mess yet. Robert’s music will do more than enhance the atmosphere while you pour drinks—it’ll provide a new source of income (you’ll split tips 50-50) and influence customer behavior. Want to encourage diners to stay for a meal? Ask him to play some background tunes. Looking to impress Casey the gravedigger or Doctor Henry? Have Robert strike up a lively melody—perfect for a brawl. With unconscious customers to save (or rob), the action never stops!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/11c2149dc813acc756e4c14934956da9b2f667f4.gif[/img]

[h2]3. It ain't much, but it's honest work
[/h2]
Here are some smaller but impactful improvements by our programmer Patryk, a specialist in seemingly “small” changes that make a huge difference:

[list]
[*] [h3]Characters finally drink from their glasses instead of spilling everywhere:[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/4feff23b9b2e87507353f2de1c2ef4fe3dc10d7a.gif[/img]
[*] [h3]A notification system to keep you updated on all the happenings in the saloon[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/09559c73675adb7a96e42f9d2f85878f24679fc5.gif[/img]
[*] [h3]Highlighting dirt and trash when using the right tools, so cleaning enthusiasts will never miss a spot[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/680cc1de5dac997120dd5b57ea37cddc0aaad732.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Our Wishes for You
[/h2]
Saloon Simulator is no longer just a demo of mechanics or a small slice of life in the Wild West. It’s growing into a full-fledged game that you can lose yourself in for hours. While there’s still much to work on, we’re incredibly proud of what we’ve built so far. We’re endlessly grateful for your kind words and the patience you’ve shown as we work toward the final version of Saloon Simulator. From chilly Gliwice in Poland, we send you all our warmest holiday greetings and wish you a Merry Christmas and/or a Happy New Year. We hope 2025 brings you joy and peace.

notes.title: Progress Report October 2024
notes.content:
[h1]What’s New in Saloon Simulator?
[/h1]
At Glivi Games, work is in full swing! The script is now in the hands of our voice actors, and they’ll be starting their recordings soon. After that, we’ll dive into implementing the voices in the game. We’re also testing new quests for Chapter Two, and there’s going to be a lot happening – with three new characters arriving in town, one of them making quite the unconventional entrance! Our graphic team is hard at work optimizing the game, aiming to make *Saloon Simulator* look great even on less powerful devices. And we’ve got some new features coming that are sure to spice up the gameplay and breathe new life into your saloon.

[h2]1. Faro – A Classic Gambling Game
[/h2]
What’s a Wild West saloon without some gambling? Have you heard of Faro? It’s a gambling game that’s mostly forgotten now, but it was wildly popular back in the day. In Faro, players try to predict which card the dealer will draw next by betting on its suit or rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/333e7feb0ac3c4222606e7f77ab3dd233f15c4bc.gif[/img]

In Chapter Two, you’ll unlock the second half of the saloon – and that’s where you’ll find a special room you can equip with entertainment. We’re starting with Faro, but we plan to add more game stations in the future. What should we work on next? Poker? Darts? Or maybe Bagatelle – the ancestor of pinball?

[h2]2. Meet Your New Companion – The Mule
[/h2]
As you may know from our previous devlog, we’re working on bringing horses to Blueberry, because what’s the Wild West without them? But while horses aren’t here just yet, let us introduce you to your new best friend for waste transport: the mule. You won’t have to run back and forth to the dump with every single trash bag anymore – just load up the mule’s saddlebags, and he and Charlie will take care of the rest. Handy, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/5d664e84fe792c9e9c92e3fb863c80169a78ded4.gif[/img]

[h2]3. Ladies and Gentlemen
[/h2]
In the prologue, the saloon’s clientele consisted mostly of men and Casey. But that’s about to change. We’ve added women to the customer pool, and they feel just as at home in the saloon as the men do. You’ll find them enjoying drinks, trying their luck at Faro, and even throwing the occasional punch!

notes.title: Progress Report August & September 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Are you ready to sign a pact with the devil?[/h1]

Dear friends! We’ve just finished working on the script and quests for Act Two of Saloon Simulator! The intrigue intensifies, and blood will be spilled. Someone will disappear, and someone will emerge. Something will explode, and someone will get shot. I can't reveal much more, but Act Two, especially its finale, will be packed with action like you've never seen in Blueberry before. Aside from the story and quests, we’ve also focused on implementing new mechanics—after all, Saloon Simulator is not just about the story but, above all, a simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/b38f113c5694a2e935cb0ceb5b79d897466374aa.png[/img]

[h2]Trait System[/h2]
From now on, each guest entering the saloon in Blueberry will have a set of 6 traits that will determine their behavior and what needs they’ll want to fulfill in your establishment. These traits are:

[list]
[*] Thirst – Desire to order a drink
[*] Hunger – Desire to order food (the hungriest guests might want to order a full meal!)
[*] Sociability – Perhaps our guest will want to stay a little longer
[*] Impulsiveness – High impulsiveness increases the chance of an aggressive reaction to a wrong order and a willingness to get involved in a fight
[*] Wealth – Determines how much money they have and the size of the tips
[*] Manners – Reduces the chance that a customer will leave a mess behind
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/ef03a2552d6b02967320c9428bb4529ffbbb26b4.gif[/img]

These traits are influenced by the decor of your saloon—the furniture and decorations you choose will increase or decrease specific traits, allowing you to decide what kind of saloon you want to run. Maybe you prefer a peaceful atmosphere and enjoy serving beans to hungry cowboys? Or perhaps you'll buy the fanciest furniture to attract wealthy visitors? Or maybe you’re after quick profits, encouraging as many fights as possible to rob (and bury in the backyard) the defeated with Casey? Now, the kind of saloon Blueberry Saloon becomes is entirely up to you.

[h2]Renting and Furnishing Rooms[/h2]
In the prologue, you could enlist Earl’s help in renovating one of the upstairs rooms. Furnishing and renting out rooms will become a key part of making money in the later stages of the game. In Act Three, courtesans will enter the scene, giving you a cut of their earnings in exchange for the rooms where they’ll invite their clients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/75d52dbf73614d4c1d3242da61dd7aeb22cd9d1e.gif[/img]

Earl will remain your best friend when it comes to renovations. To start your hotel business, order furniture from him (you'll need at least a bed to rent out a room) and choose which room he should renovate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/81adc6e3033385e938d659d9a05535770b7dd285.gif[/img]

Once Earl finishes the work, wait for the first guests looking to rent a room. When a guest leaves, don’t forget to clean up before renting it out to the next person!

[h2]Skill System
[/h2]
Through the skill system, we wanted to show how much our hero, Cheyenne, grows as a bartender and in other, less obvious aspects of the game. Cheyenne will improve his skills by completing story tasks and earning new achievements along his bartending journey—after all, every bartender knows that while a rookie might make one drink, an experienced one can easily whip up at least five.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/ed5702790fcea3da9abdc10e0de04edb36e2b891.gif[/img]

[h2]Behind-the-Scenes Bonus
[/h2]I’ve saved a little behind-the-scenes bonus for the end since this work is still in its early stages. But I thought I’d let you know because we’ve received a lot of questions about it. Yes, we know. Doesn’t something very important seem to be missing? Don’t worry—we’re working on it. The symbol of the Wild West—a horse—will soon be galloping through the streets of Blueberry!

In preparation for the Prologue release, our team has been laser-focused on squashing bugs and optimizing performance. One of our developers, Kuba, shared a particularly pesky issue he dubbed the "[b]Schrödinger's Piano Stool Problem.[/b]" This stool, intended for our saloon's future musician, was temporarily removed from the game. notes.title: Progress Report - March 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Hello future Saloon owners!
[/h1]
As March rolls in, bringing the promise of spring, we're back with another exciting development log for Saloon Simulator. Without further ado, let's dive into the new features and enhancements we're currently working on.

[h2]Sheriff's Patrols
[/h2]Playing outlaw in Blueberry became significantly more challenging with the arrival of Hank Custer – a man of high society, a charmer, and an unmatched horseshoe player. Our developers have been hard at work implementing his patrol mechanics. Engaging in criminal activities, such as disposing of bodies or dismantling wagons, will now raise his suspicions. Carelessness will swiftly land you behind bars. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/a773cc86daad436aca24ab466c555793e77743c8.gif[/img]

[h3]Better hide![/h3]
However, you can distract him by serving stronger drinks than he's accustomed to. Maintain your saloon's reputation and a good relationship with Hank to lower his vigilance. In dire situations, where you must dispose of a VIP's body unnoticed, find cover in bushes or behind buildings to avoid his prying eyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/35b7f74c090a388d055ae1880067c0c2718c81c7.gif[/img]

[h2]Town expansion and time progression
[/h2]Dedicated care for your saloon and reconciling the town folks' conflicting interests will mean you'll spend a lot of time in Blueberry. The saloon's success will attract travelers with full purses, benefiting both you and the local artisans. These craftsmen will invest the money earned—not only in refurbishing their workshops but also, along with you, in enhancing the shared spaces of the community. A beautiful symbol of life returning to the town will be the flora that flourishes over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/b69250c902f43912700039c16baa26eda97a10f1.gif[/img]

[h2]Save system
[/h2]Completing all tasks in Saloon Simulator Prologue will take around 2 hours, but that doesn't have to be the end of your adventure! After finishing the main storyline, you can continue playing, using the money earned in subsequent days to purchase upgrades and decorations for your saloon. We're currently working on a save system to ensure that the time you've invested in earning money and beautifying your saloon is not lost, allowing you to return to our game whenever you need a moment of relaxation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/c409a6417156e605aeabf5f96b34b556fa80f0ee.gif[/img]

notes.content:
As we stride closer to the grand unveiling of Saloon Simulator Prologue, excitement is in the air! Our developers have been tirelessly fine-tuning the mechanics and squashing those pesky bugs. We've been laser-focused on enhancing the demolition and destruction mechanics (watch those stolen wagons go down!),

Our 3D artists are facing a monumental task – filling Blueberry with objects, furniture, and various bits and pieces. Our town might not be the largest, but we're committed to stuffing it to the brim with content. This enables us to open up previously inaccessible buildings whose interiors were not yet finished.

notes.content:
Hello fellow Saloon owners!

Happy New Year! We hope you all had a wonderful holiday season. Our team managed to get some well-deserved rest, but now we're back at it again, working full steam ahead on Saloon Simulator's prologue. This is where we'll present our full vision of the game's core mechanics - a vision we're eager to modify based on your feedback. We can't wait to show you the fruits of several months of hard work. 

Our writers and 2D artists have been working closely together over the past month, resulting in not only a variety of handwritten letters and in-game notes, but also beautiful illustrations that will grace the pages of our journal.

The prologue storyline is now playable from beginning to end, but many mechanics still require refinement to ensure they are clear, visually appealing, and sound just right. In the midst of these improvements, we've also found time to add an entirely new feature - the unpacking mechanic. Our supplier, Jack, brings in crates of food and alcohol, which you'll need to unpack and place on the appropriate shelves in your saloon. It may seem like a small addition, but trust us - unpacking has never been so much fun. Take a look for yourself!

notes.title: Progress Report - October 2023
notes.content:
It's that time of the month again and we're excited to share with you the latest developments in the world of Saloon Simulator. October has been a busy month for our team and we've got some exciting updates to share with you.

[b]1. Master the art of mixology[/b]

At the heart of Saloon Simulator is the art of making drinks. As a saloon owner, this is your primary task, and we've been hard at work refining the mechanics to make it more immersive and enjoyable. While there are plenty of activities to keep you busy in the town, mixing drinks is without a doubt the backbone of your business.

This month we've focused on improving the flow of drink preparation. By giving you control over the angle at which you tilt the bottle, we've made it easier for you to adjust the pour rate of alcohol and additives. We've eliminated unnecessary clicks and simplified the whole process. Adding ice and stirring your concoctions now requires mouse movement, not just spacebars. It's all about creating a more hands-on and realistic experience for you, our dedicated bartenders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/8ccd2246497283f230115bfe59096ce4ce6e6b41.png[/img]

[b]2. Furnish Your Saloon - 200+ Unique Options![/b]

Our talented graphic designers have worked tirelessly to bring you an ever-expanding catalogue of furniture for you to purchase and place in your saloon. The number of unique pieces of furniture has already grown to over 200, and the best part is that you can customise the colour of each item. This gives you endless possibilities to make your saloon your own. It's all about creating a unique atmosphere that reflects your style and hospitality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/7a3b2052bf9271b42c5850cdde99806484b2b7b8.gif[/img]

[b]3. Meet Resourceful Charlie - Blueberry's Jack of All Trades[/b]

At Blueberry, resourcefulness and craftsmanship are highly valued, and that's where Charlie comes in. He's Blueberry's jack-of-all-trades - a rubbish collector, treasure hunter and inventor all rolled into one. In his rare moments of leisure, Charlie devotes his time to tinkering, creating remarkable inventions from simple materials, much like the legendary MacGyver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/7d8ad77243d5f385ca7d74c6e971262597d31039.png[/img]

Charlie is not only a collector of discarded items, he's also a unique merchant. His shop is notable not only for its eclectic selection, but also for the unconventional currency he accepts. To acquire one of Charlie's treasures, you'll have to go on a scavenger hunt, collecting items scattered around Blueberry that can be reused as payment.

We hope you're as excited as we are about these exciting developments. As always, we invite you to join us on our Discord channel https://discord.gg/SKNNd2Byu8 where you can stay connected with the Saloon Simulator community and share your thoughts, ideas and feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates, and until next time

Best regards,

The Saloon Simulator Team.

notes.title: Progress Report - September 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're back in the saddle with another exciting update on the wild journey of Saloon Simulator. If you enjoyed our previous devlogs, you're in for a real treat. Let's dive right into the exciting developments of the last month!

1. Bottles and Faces - A Toast to Visual Excellence

A saloon without a carefully curated selection of spirits is like a desert without cacti - it just ain't right! Our resident graphic artist has poured her heart and soul into creating the labels for our specialty liquor bottles. These bottles are more than just containers; they're veritable works of art that embody the spirit (pun intended) of the Wild West. Keep your eyes peeled for these exquisite bottles as you build your collection and whip up brews that'll have your patrons begging for seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/c91e88d3a2864dbba69fe9471b2ec0e49889592b.png[/img]

But that's not all, folks! It's time to reintroduce you to some familiar faces. Remember Cassidy from the demo? Well, say hello to Sam - he's undergone a transformation and is back with a new name and even more charisma. Our dedicated 3D modeling team has brought these characters to life, making sure they're as visually memorable as they are crucial to the story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/30f2bea98bb24dc7b32e372402230233b8bf793a.png[/img]

2. Meet the new and improved Jack - your go-to business partner

Jack, the trader from the demo, is back in the spotlight. He will undergo a remarkable transformation in the prologue. As an experienced trader, Jack stands out from the crowd, always looking for opportunities to make a quick buck. When business is booming, Jack will be your most important ally, making sure Blueberry never runs out of essentials like food and alcohol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/859f2c8e7ef9d7b35ba25ea05b1230f40a163674.png[/img]

Now it's time to introduce you to a new character we're very excited about. It turns out that the same train that brought the sheriff also left another passenger on the platform. Earl, the assistant carpenter, has arrived to revive the workshop. He's an experienced craftsman and a real handyman. But there's a catch - he's very skeptical of strangers. With the saloon in need of renovation and new furnishings, earning Earl's trust will be your first priority in the Prologue. Who knows? Along the way, you might uncover some of Blueberry's well-guarded secrets.

That's it for this devlog, folks. As always, we encourage you to join us on our Discord channel (https://discord.gg/SKNNd2Byu8) for more updates, discussions, and the chance to share your thoughts and ideas. We're excited to have you on this ride as we continue to shape the world of Saloon Simulator.

Stay tuned for more updates, and until next time, keep your spurs jingling and your glasses clinking!

The Saloon Simulator Team.

notes.title: Progress Report - August 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/66a8ca651a61cf5c7b99f6ba613959c6d5c27a3c.png[/img]Hello fellow bartenders!

We hope this devlog finds you well, and we're excited to share the latest happenings from the dusty trails of our Saloon Simulator project. First and foremost, we'd like to thank you all for the incredible interest and enthusiasm you've shown for our game. Your support and dedication has been nothing short of inspiring. A special shout out goes to those of you who took the time to fill out our post-demo survey - your feedback was invaluable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/c2de5196348f6d805bd2f877bfa6fc853033ec79.jpg[/img]

After releasing our playable demo at the end of June, we took a moment to catch our breath and chart the course ahead. We've had some intense discussions about the survey results, pondered the aspects you loved, and considered how to address mechanics that didn't quite hit the mark. Our talented programming team has been hard at work implementing both minor and major improvements to various mechanics. Mixing drinks and cooking now feels even more satisfying and immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/454d3bd7061d79c2192a79261e518f3eb7086f98.jpg[/img]

One of our main focuses was to improve the customization mechanics. We realized that on certain systems, customization wasn't as stable as we wanted it to be. Some options weren't accessible, and changing your salon's decor wasn't as intuitive as we wanted it to be. Our goal is to make it a breeze to customize your salon to your unique style - an enjoyable experience that lets you create something truly special. 
Right now, we're deep into creating the prologue, which we hope will set the tone for the entire game. The prologue's story will be twice as long as the demo's story and will revolve around the introduction of a new character in Blueberry - Earl, a handy carpenter's assistant. In the full game, you'll rely on him to provide new furniture for your saloon. The prologue will also pick up the story threads of W and Sheriff Custer, shedding light on the mysterious past of the previous saloon owner and his connection to the mysterious Uncle. As a new mechanic, you'll be able to rent rooms to guests who want to stay a while. We've also already implemented an options menu for a smoother experience.

Our 3D art team is hard at work creating new models for the Blueberry's residents and patrons. We're determined to give each drink and dish its own unique look and description. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/03062b93f1d512822d78b1c1d9b9cbbf1050419a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/ffeb1ccdada57dd8b5876cd38bb1ce7b7eb230f5.png[/img]

Meanwhile, our 2D artists are hard at work creating new illustrations for the protagonist's journal, as well as images that will grace your cookbooks, bartender guides, saloon walls, and even the interiors of Blueberry's homes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/24eaa3c6d064e519cda5fb8b7f3c7712d65b6818.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/986d3d0410e04177babb2db286958cf2dc558dd7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/23c405a9ad4448c7c547bb705222dcaf7eb66aab.jpg[/img]

We invite you all to join us on our Discord server (https://discord.gg/SKNNd2Byu8) where we share our weekly progress updates every Monday. It's also a place where you can ask us questions, share your ideas for improving the game, and connect with other players who share your excitement.

In closing, we'd like to once again express our deepest gratitude. Your unwavering support and enthusiasm fuels our determination to create an unforgettable Saloon Simulator experience. Together, we're shaping a game that captures the essence of the Wild West in a way we could only dream of.

Yeehaw, partners! See you behind bar!

Warmest Regards,

The Saloon Simulator Team.
